दह १

DAHA I . One of the eleven Rudras. He was the grandson of brahmā and the son of sthāṇu. (mahābhārata, Ādi Parva, Chapter 66, Stanza 3).

दह २

DAHA II . An attendant given to subrahmaṇya by aṁśa, a god. (mahābhārata, śalya Parva, Chapter 45, Stanza 34).

दहदहा

DAHADAHĀ . An attendant of subrahmaṇya. (mahābhārata, śalya Parva, Chapter 46, Stanza 20).

दहति

DAHATI . A warrior given to subrahmaṇya by god aṁśa. Mention is made about this warrior in mahābhārata, śalya Parva, Chapter 45, Stanza 34.
